titre: Changing schools during the school year (moving, certificat de radiation)
resume: Moving your child to a new primary school, middle school (collège) or high school (lycée) mid-year: certificat de radiation, registration at the town hall then at the school, exact documents, and the case of separated parents.
aQuoiCaSert: A child can change schools during the year, for example after a move or a separation. The change is never automatic: it depends on available places. The previous school issues a certificat de radiation (certificate of withdrawal from the school roll), which you need to enroll the child in the new one. For public nursery and primary schools, registration goes through the town hall (mairie) first.
quiEstConcerne: Parents moving during the school year, within the same town or elsewhere in Mayotte.
Separated parents whose child changes main residence.
Parents who want a different school, collège or lycée from the one in their catchment area.
aSavoir: Public school, another school in the same town: you need the mayor's approval, who issues a registration certificate (certificat d'inscription). In another town: approval from the mayor of your town of residence and from the mayor of the receiving town.

Separated parents: if one parent objects to the change of school, the principal must wait for the decision of the family court judge (juge aux affaires familiales, JAF) to whom that parent has applied. It is best to have the written agreement of both parents who hold parental authority.
If a judgment gives you sole parental authority, show it to the school and the town hall.

Collège or lycée in your catchment area: get the certificat de radiation (exeat) from the previous school, then enroll the child at the new one. If there are no places left, the education authority's services assign the student.
Collège or lycée outside your catchment area: you first need the approval of the director of education services (directeur académique) before enrolling.
